items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I can’t think of -- the early trio. But anyway those guys were -- they were the number one guys around town at that time, you know.

ctx.x: Vi Redd, right. Her father was a drummer. He had his own band, group, and Prince, Wesley Prince, I think that was his name, who was the brother of the bass player at that time that was with Nat Cole, with Nat. I can’t think of -- the early trio. But anyway those guys were -- they were the number one guys around town at that time, you know.
So you got a chance to see really good drummers.

items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I learned that from Nat... I just, you know, sort of copied stuff.

ctx.x: And it sounds funny -- it’s not funny, but you know who played at my wedding? Nat.
Yeah. MR. BROLWN: He played for the wedding reception. That’s an (unintelligible).
